# maniva, AI-ready documentation for tricot

> One entry point to the AgrDataSci resources on tricot and product testing with users. Each layer (published evidence, protocols, trial data, analytical approaches) lives in its own repository, with its own skill, rules and citation.

Write maniva and tricot in lowercase, always, including at the start of a sentence. tricot stands for triadic comparison of technology options.

Read SKILL.md before answering. It routes each question to the right layer.

## Core files

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/maniva/main/SKILL.md): which layer answers which question, and how to use it
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/maniva/main/AGENTS.md): short instructions for AI agents
- [version.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/maniva/main/version.json): suite version and the commit SHA of the current files, stamped on every push to main
- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/maniva/main/README.md): overview of the layers
- [PROVENANCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/maniva/main/PROVENANCE.md): why the history is never rewritten, and how to verify it
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/maniva/main/CHANGELOG.md): releases and every correction

## Layers

- [tricot-knowledge-base](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-knowledge-base/main/SKILL.md): verified cards on the published evidence, with a skill
- [tricot-protocols](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-protocols/main/README.md): standard operating procedures, surveys and trait metadata
- [tricot-data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-data/main/README.md): harmonized trial data, listed in data/aa-available-datasets.csv
- [tricot-analysis-workflows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/tricot-analysis-workflows/main/SKILL.md): the team's curated analytical use cases and decision records, including how trial data link with climate and environmental data
- R packages gosset, ClimMobTools, climatrends and chirps (CRAN) and [ClimMob-analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/ClimMob-analysis/master/README.md): the tools the analysis layer runs on
- [template-repo-data-analysis](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgrDataSci/template-repo-data-analysis/main/SKILL.md): part of the analysis layer, a template for FAIR and reproducible analysis projects
